scope: bounded CPU systems profile only; no fit, GPU, target/mask decode, metric, score or public-transfer claim

page_cache_scope.first_timed_pass_label: first observed replay after cache build and full parity validation; kernel page-cache state is unknown, not cold
page_cache_scope.repeats_label: subsequent repeated passes after prior accesses; not an independently controlled warm-cache condition
page_cache_scope.parquet_features_accessed_before_timing: yes, during cache build and exact parity validation
page_cache_scope.mmap_features_accessed_before_timing: yes, during exact parity validation; file was just generated

break_even.scope: this valid_subset20 cohort only; no full-training extrapolation
break_even.reason: first integer K for which measured cache build + exact parity validation + mmap open plus K mapped epochs is strictly faster on this 20-sequence subset

limitations: Only 20 complete sequences were measured; the result does not establish full-train throughput.
Targets, scored masks, data staging, model compute, training-loader workers and optimizer work were excluded.
The feature cache uses 179.2 MB raw float32 payload; a 10,535-sequence cache would need approximately 94.3936 GB before other arrays and is not admitted here.
No controlled cold-page-cache observation was made; the first timed replay followed feature reads during build and parity validation.
The common NumPy sum is an all-values-touch surrogate, not a training step; end-to-end training speedup may differ.
